This is Reserve Protocol Electronic Dollar eUSD (RToken), not Reservoir, Re Protocol, Resupply or Rezerve. issue/issueTo amount and redeem/redeemTo amount are 18-decimal eUSD base units. The internal mint(uint192) is BackingManager-only and is excluded; ordinary user minting is issue.

Issue pulls every token of the current collateral basket from msg.sender using individual token allowances to the eUSD RToken contract, sending collateral to the configured BackingManager. It mints eUSD to caller or explicit recipient. Use current BasketHandler quote; source warns against infinite approvals. Inputs are collateral wrapper shares, not raw USDC/USDT/PYUSD; amounts use each collateral token native decimals.

Observed current official basket contains saEthUSDT, wcUSDCv3, gtusdcf, gtusdcp and senPYUSDmain (Aave USDT V3, wrapped Compound USDC V3 and three Morpho V2 vault shares). Composition is governable and not pinned by these function arguments. Source basket conversion uses basketsNeeded/totalSupply, ceiling for issue and floor for redemption; issuance quote includes a collateral issuance premium. No fixed dollar exchange rate or fixed basket promise.

Issue requires nonzero amount, issuance unpaused/unfrozen and a SOUND ready basket outside its warmup period. Ordinary redemption burns caller-owned eUSD without an allowance/delegated owner and transfers the current basket to caller/recipient; it is allowed with issuance/trading pause but not freeze and requires full collateralization. Undercollateralized or historical-basket redeemCustom is not admitted.

This 4.2.0 RToken implementation performs issue/redemption atomically, not the old delayed-issuance queue. Per-hour issuance/redemption throttles may force waiting/retrying; they do not create a funded pending redemption claim. Official settings observed basket warmup 15 minutes, issuance unpaused and system unfrozen; states may change. The separate two-week RSR unstaking delay is NOT an eUSD redemption delay and staking is not admitted.

No per-call min-output/max-input/deadline in the four admitted functions. Basket updates, rounding, premiums, asset refresh/oracles, collateral token restrictions and BackingManager allowances can affect/revert settlement. The RToken methods have no explicit user KYC whitelist; frontend/underlying legal and token restrictions remain caller responsibilities, not waived by ABI permissionlessness.

Central Sourcify implementation request returned 404, so explorer ABI/source were used; old constructor implementation was not substituted.

functions.label: Cancel sender-owned cancelable stream
warnings: Static deployment-bound source/ABI inventory only; no fresh runtime identity, execution, funding, balances, liquidity, complete-workflow or financial-safety assurance. Independent exact-function grants, pauses and canonical-calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Ethereum Lockup v4.0 is the current official non-upgradeable deployment, not Legacy, older Lockup versions, BatchLockup or the discontinued Lockup Periphery. Linked helpers/math are deployment-bound compile-time dependencies; mutable comptroller, NFT descriptor and hook allowlist are not attested as permanent configuration.

Creation deposits depositAmount raw units of the caller-selected ERC20, transferred atomically from msg.sender with allowance to this Lockup. The stream sender is a separate caller-specified address that receives cancellation authority and refunds; the funder need not be that sender. The recipient is the minted stream NFT owner and may change if transferable=true. No standalone prefunding or native-token streaming is admitted.

Duration creation starts at block.timestamp; timestamp creation can vest according to an explicit past or future schedule. LL has start/cliff unlock amounts and floor-rounded granularity (0 means 1 second), with remaining tokens vesting after the cliff or start. LD uses chronological segment amounts and unsigned 18-decimal fixed-point exponents with fixed-point rounding. LT releases whole tranche amounts at their timestamps. Segments/tranches must sum to depositAmount; end time equals final timestamp. shape is at most 32 bytes of event/display metadata, not executable calldata.

withdraw/withdrawMax pay at most vested minus already-withdrawn raw token units. Anyone can trigger payment to the current NFT recipient; redirecting to another address requires that recipient or an existing approved NFT operator. functions.label: Upshift Claim recorded USDC redemption
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only, not proof of current runtime bytecode identity, execution success, funding, liquidity, complete workflows or financial safety. Zero native value is required; independent grants, pauses, canonical-calldata and safety controls remain authoritative.

This is Upshift own Ethereum upUSDC lending pool, not a second AugustVaults protocol and not a curator wrapper over an already admitted protocol. Current official API identifies chain 1, Upshift USDC, status active and withdrawal_only=false. Older initial implementation 0x43D41393124Dfca45567Ef005F5C79311C57c65b from deployment docs is not the reported current LendingPoolv3 implementation 0xc0026E559dA7F2d4eE573616C09A8F721fa599bd; source-service runtime/creation status for that implementation is match, not exact_match.

Underlying is Ethereum USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 with 6 decimals; upUSDC shares also have 6 decimals in the explorer snapshot. deposit spends exact USDC base units via caller allowance to this pool and rounds shares down, rejecting zero shares. mint specifies share base units, rounds required assets up and uses caller USDC allowance. Supply and per-deposit caps, receiver validity, configured asset and blacklists apply. Neither entry has a caller-set minimum shares, maximum assets or deadline.

requestRedeem takes share base units from holderAddr into pool custody rather than burning immediately; a different caller needs existing holder share allowance. It computes floor-rounded underlying, subtracts floor withdrawalFee*basis/10000, rejects zero proceeds and fixes receiver/date claim accounting. No standalone prefunding or admin loan funding is admitted. With lagDuration=0 the request immediately calls _claim and burns the escrowed shares; otherwise the receiver/date is claimable at the UTC processing hour on the date of block.timestamp+5 minutes+lagDuration. This is not a guaranteed exact-duration delay.

Anyone may call claim for a recorded receiver and date, but funds always go to that receiver; returns are (sharesBurned, assetsTransferred), despite generic docs describing a different order. Shares burn only when claim settles. Configured withdrawal pause and caller/holder/receiver blacklists can revert ordinary exits; insufficient pool-held USDC reverts payment. Batch settlement, privileged loans and collateral/liquidation management are excluded. ERC4626 withdraw/redeem unconditionally revert WithdrawalRequestRequired and are excluded; instantRedeem described by the generic interface is absent from this deployed ABI.

Explorer point-in-time fields show depositsPaused=false, withdrawalsPaused=false, lagDuration=0, liquidationHour=0, managementFeePercent=0, withdrawalFee=0. These are not persistent state guarantees. Owner can change fees, blacklist accounts, pause entries/exits, manage loans and upgrade the proxy; timelock duration changes consume a configured scheduler call. Management fees reduce asset accounting when charged; totalAssets includes loan principal plus pool USDC minus accrued fees, not only immediately available cash.

Official docs permit partner-specific KYC and wallet screening. Reviewed direct entry bodies enforce blacklisting, not an affirmative KYC allowlist; this does not establish user legal eligibility or permission to use institutional features. No APR, collateral adequacy or loan repayment assertion is made.

functions.label: LlamaPay cancelStream
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only, not proof of current runtime bytecode identity, execution success, funding, liquidity, complete workflows or financial safety. Only the fixed Ethereum USDC LlamaPay streaming instance 0x3e67cc2c7fff86d9870db9d02c43e789b52fb296 is admitted. Official live Ethereum factory 0xde1C04855c2828431ba637675B6929A684f84C7F getter getLlamaPayContractByToken(USDC) returned this address with isDeployed=true; exact-address Sourcify ABI/source and explorer token() bind USDC. This is salary stream accounting and claim functionality, not a bare token-transfer integration or arbitrary executor.

deposit and combined depositAndCreate methods spend caller-owned USDC base units (6 decimals) using allowance to this instance and credit only caller payer accounting. amountPerSec, balances and withdrawPayer(amount) instead use internal 20-decimal units; DECIMALS_DIVISOR=100000000000000 converts between units. withdrawPayer divides its internal-unit amount down, and withdrawPayerAll removes the caller available balance after accrued obligations, not other payers funds.

createStream and reason variants create a positive-rate stream identified by payer msg.sender, recipient and exact uint216 rate; an identical active stream is rejected. Existing payer accrued obligations must be fully covered before a new stream can be created. Streams have no encoded maturity or end date; caller must cancel/pause/modify explicitly. createStream does not itself fund future obligations. Combined methods atomically deposit then create; a failure reverts both.

withdraw can be triggered by anyone, but exact (from,to,amountPerSec) must identify an existing stream and payout always goes to its recorded to address. Payment is limited to elapsed funded time across all streams of that payer; underfunding advances only to the common paid timestamp and leaves remaining unpaid time, with no automatic loan or funding guarantee. Integer division floors USDC payment; a small claim can send zero while advancing time, discarding fractional-token dust. No caller-set minimum output, maximum input or deadline exists.

pauseStream and cancelStream both invoke the same _cancelStream: settle the currently funded portion to its existing recipient, remove the stream and reduce payer rate. Pause is not a special resumable state; recreation is a new stream. Underfunded cancellation does not guarantee all past salary will be paid. modifyStream atomically cancels the old caller-owned stream (paying old recipient) then creates the new recipient/rate; failure reverts the full change.

Reason strings are emitted only in StreamCreatedWithReason; they are not decoded as instructions or external calls. Opaque self-delegatecall batch(bytes[],bool) and permitToken arbitrary-token authorization wrapper remain excluded; no callback/admin/approval capability is granted. All selected transfers use the constructor-fixed USDC token with no user-selected external execution target. The reviewed instance has no own pause, role, KYC, blacklist or upgrade entry; USDC issuer restrictions and applicable jurisdictional eligibility still remain outside this inventory.

Ethereum Drips V2 AddressDriver uses fixed Drips hub 0xd0Dd053392db676D57317CD4fe96Fc2cCf42D0b4, driver ID 0, and trusted ERC-2771 Caller 0x60F25ac5F289Dc7F640f948521d486C964A248e5. Normal direct calls derive account ID from msg.sender; only the configured forwarder can supply forwarded identity. Arbitrary Caller batching/authorization surfaces and other drivers are not admitted. Both hub and driver are upgradeable and separately pausable.

give and positive setStreams balanceDelta pull ERC20 from the caller directly into the fixed hub using allowance to AddressDriver, atomically with bookkeeping. collect and negative realBalanceDelta withdraw only the just-collected/released amount to transferTo. No raw hub prefunding, standalone withdraw, ERC20 approval, authorization or arbitrary execution capability is added.

Only amount-preserving ERC20s are supported by source: rebasing, fee/tax-on-transfer and holding/transfer-restricted tokens can become stuck or lost. Amounts are token base units. Native ETH is not accepted by these functions. Source has no protocol usage fee; gas and any external app fees are separate.

setStreams requires the exact current receivers list hash, and new receivers sorted by accountId then config without duplicates, at most 100, with valid nonzero rates. StreamConfig is data, not executable routing: streamId32 | amtPerSec160 | start32 | duration32. Rates have 9 extra decimals (multiply token base units/second by 1e9); zero start means now and zero duration means until balance exhaustion. Rate minimum is 1654 in this 604800-second deployment; integer rounding, balance exhaustion and uint32 timestamp bounds apply. maxEndHint1/2 are binary-search gas hints, not deadlines or execution instructions. Negative balanceDelta is capped at the remaining unstreamed balance; actual released amount can be less than requested.

receiveStreams settles completed 604800-second cycles, bounded by maxCycles, into the named account's splittable balance, not a direct wallet payout. squeezeStreams can settle elapsed current-cycle amounts using senderId/historyHash/StreamsHistory proofs hashed against the stored final history; these fields do not select external calls. Either is permissionless but cannot redirect credit from accountId. Both still require split followed by the relevant driver collect to transfer tokens.

setSplits changes the caller account's future distribution for every ERC20. Up to 200 receivers, strictly sorted unique account IDs, positive uint32 weights, and total weight at most 1,000,000. split requires the exact stored receiver hash and sends weighted amounts to their splittable balances, leaving residual collectable for the originating account. Cumulative floor rounding applies; anyone may split under the old configuration before a pending update. A 100% self-split loops credit back to splittable and prevents normal collection until reconfigured.

The protocol does not require registration for address-based accounts; repository ownership, NFT ownership and RetroPGF eligibility/KYC are separate driver/app flows not admitted here. Sending to exchange-custodial addresses that cannot sign collection may strand funds. No inferred jurisdiction/KYC clearance, entitlement, payout timing or claim availability is asserted.

functions.label: Mellow Finance Cancel pending USDC deposit
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only, not persistent runtime identity, backing, funding, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or complete-workflow assurance. Exact grants, independent policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls still apply.

Mellow Finance own Core Vault architecture is reviewed through the live Ethereum earnUSD USDC queues and vault 0x014e6da8f283c4af65b2aa0f201438680a004452. Lido is product owner/distributor; Mellow supplies Core architecture and curation. This is not an additional Lido stETH staking label or a Morpho curator-only wrapper; no deprecated Mellow-LRT, closed-to-deposits stRATEGY, signature queues, arbitrary curator execution or unsupported chain is admitted.

deposit pulls positive uint224 USDC assets from msg.sender into the fixed deposit queue via allowance to that queue. It records one caller-owned request; a previous processed request is auto-claimed, while an unprocessed request prevents a new deposit. referral is emitted as metadata, not a recipient or call target. merkleProof authenticates depositor membership, not executable calldata. RiskManager pending-asset limits, whitelist/account permissions and queue pause can reject deposits.

The deposit ABI is payable for the shared ETH/ERC20 queue implementation, but this exact queue asset is USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 (6 decimals). Use zero native value. The ERC20 transfer branch does not reject or refund attached ETH; attached ETH is not the USDC deposit and can be stranded. Other selected functions are nonpayable.

cancelDepositRequest cancels only msg.sender unprocessed request and refunds its original USDC amount to msg.sender. Cancellation reverts after a covering price report. claim(account) on DepositQueue is permissionless but can mint only that account allocated shares; it cannot redirect them to caller. It returns false if not priced, and a tiny deposit may floor to zero shares and still be consumed.

redeem locks only msg.sender shares in the fixed ShareManager, first claiming matured deposit shares as part of lock. Concrete TokenizedShareManager uses an internal share transfer, not transferFrom or delegated allowance. Queue records caller requests by uint32 timestamp; same-timestamp requests aggregate. Redemption requests cannot be cancelled. Shares are burned when a vault-authorized oracle report prices the batch, not when assets are claimed.

RedeemQueue claim(receiver,timestamps) spends only msg.sender recorded requests and can send resulting USDC to intentional receiver. Missing, already-claimed, unpriced or unsettled timestamps are skipped rather than ensuring any payout. Claim requires both pricing and later liquidity settlement through handleBatches, a separate permissionless keeper operation excluded here. No payout deadline, cancellation right, minimum shares/output or maximum wait is provided.

Oracle priceD18 means shares per asset base unit at 1e18 precision, not USD per 18-decimal token. Deposit share entitlement floors assets times fee-reduced price /1e18; redemption batch assets floor net shares times 1e18/price, and claims floor shares times remaining batch assets /remaining batch shares (claim ordering can affect rounding dust). Deposit fee floors price times depositFeeD6/1e6; redemption fee floors shares times redeemFeeD6/1e6 and is waived for feeRecipient. Current observed deposit/redeem feeD6 are zero; management/performance fees and future configuration remain authoritative.

Point-in-time source/RPC binds current implementations: deposit 0x00000006da9f179bfe250dd1c51cd2d3581930c8, redeem 0x000000000c139266ba06170ed1deaca6d11903c1, vault 0x0000000615b2771511daa693ac07be5622869e01, ShareManager 0x000000000c79d2b5cd58ae545afc83030233d7b6. Queue proxy EIP1967 slot observations agree with source-service resolution; proxies remain upgradeable. No reliance on only initial implementations.

Observed queue assets/vault match official attribution, queues are unpaused, share decimals=18, ShareManager flags all false and Merkle root zero; these observations do not guarantee future eligibility. Global/account mint/burn/transfer pauses, lockups, blacklists and governance changes remain enforced by ShareManager. No KYC, jurisdiction or sanctions clearance is asserted.

Queue processing depends on external oracle reports, vault liquidity, RiskManager, FeeManager, ShareManager and curator allocations. Vault report handling calls only configured queue selectors, and vault callHook delegatecalls its configured hook: observed deposit hook 0x00000004d3b17e5391eb571ddb8fdf95646ca827 and redeem hook 0x0000000637f1b1ccda4af2db6cddf5e5ec45fd93. Those mutable dependencies are not isolated or made safe by this admission; no arbitrary target/selector/bytes entrypoint is activated.

Sourcify has full exact_match proxy and vault/share implementation sources but no record for these deposit/redeem implementations. Origami Finance SKY+ is its own Ethereum OrigamiDelegated4626Vault 0x07c5500359161b81eb0DfFF83097d5025D3cF5A2, not a relabeled Morpho curator vault. It issues 18-decimal SKY+ shares for SKY 0x56072c95faa701256059aa122697b133aded9279. Direct vault and current manager 0xc522335fBfe21d7A7d1135eb0E016a89DA49dC9e have exact_match source and no proxy; elevated governance can replace the manager and token-prices dependency.

deposit/mint atomically pull SKY from msg.sender directly to the configured manager via allowance to the vault, then manager locks it in immutable Sky LockstakeEngine 0xce01c90de7fd1bcfa39e237fe6d8d9f569e8a6a3 in its own urn. Shares mint to receiver, which need not be caller. No arbitrary zap/swap bytes, caller-selected manager, flash callback or standalone prefunding capability is admitted.

withdraw/redeem spend caller allowance on sharesOwner only when caller differs from owner, burn owner shares, and ask the manager (onlyVault) to free SKY directly to nonzero receiver. Fees from Sky unstaking are reflected in withdrawalFeeBps rounded up from WAD to basis points; manager gross-ups assets with floor rounding before LockstakeEngine.free. Actual assetsWithdrawn from manager is ignored by vault hook, so advertised assets are not a persistent exact-output guarantee when external fee/rounding changes.

Conversions use (totalSupply+assetScalar)/(totalAssets+1) virtual offsets; this SKY vault has scalar=1. deposit/redeem round outputs down, mint/withdraw round requirements up. In-kind deposit/withdraw fees affect shares; no caller-set minimum shares/assets, maximum assets/shares or deadline argument exists. Current observed deposit/exit fees were zero and performance fee allocation 0/200 bps; rates/settings are mutable and not promised.

Vault totalAssets includes manager idle SKY plus Sky Vat urn collateral and excludes unclaimed rewards and non-SKY rewards already forwarded for Cow Swap. Harvest timing, donations, Sky farm changes, conversion rounding and reinvestment affect share price. Rewards harvesting/swapping/admin controls are not admitted; configured reward swapper/farms remain dependencies, not isolation or backing guarantees.

Deposits/mints are subject to maxTotalSupply, seeding and manager pause; withdrawals/redeems to share balance/allowance, exit pause and external Sky availability/restrictions. maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are share-based and do not attest immediate external cash availability; no asynchronous request/claim queue is implemented by these selected entrypoints. Fully exiting resets supply cap to zero and requires privileged reseeding before future deposits.

Primary current docs list SKY+ outside Deprecated Vaults and describe its SKY staking/reward-harvesting strategy; current official app bundle includes this exact token/deployment and SKY+ collection. V3 OPAL products are distinct and not silently substituted for this V2 SKY+ vault. Source has no selected-function KYC/user whitelist but this is not app/jurisdictional eligibility clearance.

unstakeETH(uint256) is an immediate attempt: it converts caller nETH shares to floor-rounded native ETH, gathers configured execution/consensus-vault funds if needed, burns caller shares, then sends ETH only to caller with empty calldata. Insufficient funds or a rejecting recipient contract reverts. It does not automatically create a delayed withdrawal; no liquidity/timing promise.

requestWithdrawals(uint256) is the distinct asynchronous path and reverts CanUnstakeETH if the pool's own ETH balance already covers the requested payout. It burns caller nETH immediately, reduces accounting, and records fixed claimAmount and request block under caller; queued claims no longer accrue staking yield. It checks raw pool balance rather than the immediate exit's aggregate vault-funding logic. No FIFO priority or complete reservation of all earlier queue obligations is promised.

claimWithdrawals(receiver,requestIds) is permissionless settlement of requests OWNED BY receiver; receiver is both queue key and fixed payout recipient, not a way to redirect someone else's claims. All IDs must exist, have nonzero stored withdrawalAmount, be unclaimed and mature; repeated/already claimed IDs revert the batch. State marks all selected requests claimed before funds gathering and empty-calldata native ETH payout, with atomic revert on failure.

Observed withdrawalDelayBlocks is 36000, not a guaranteed 7-day duration; source initializes 50400 and governance may set up to 72000 blocks. Maturity uses current delay at claim time, so governance changes affect already queued claims. Delay is a minimum block eligibility test, not a payout deadline; vault liquidity, pauses and recipient behavior can still prevent settlement. Request storage narrows withdrawalAmount/claimAmount to uint128 and exchange to uint96; ordinary quantities must fit those source bounds.

Exchange accounting is NOT a live reserve/backing price: Rate.sol accrues estimated yield from mutable rate-manager APR and block count, only when underlying accounting is at least 32 ETH, with integer rounding and first-deposit 1:1 fallback. No minimum output, maximum input or deadline is encoded by selected methods; no explicit direct stake/exit fee, but execution-layer rewards are reduced by mutable PoolConfig DAO commission and DAO strategy/validator management affect funds.

Permissioned fund: current manager documentation requires both non-U.S. and BVI professional-investor status, KYC/AML review, signed fund documents and wallet whitelisting. Source checks the share receiver against the configured lenderVerifier, a wrapper over a manager-controlled global whitelist; a different receiver changes ownership and must be intentional. Catalog membership does not satisfy legal eligibility or whitelist requirements.

deposit and mint pull USDC from msg.sender with allowance to this tranche, atomically minting shares to receiver. Live-state net assets go directly to the fixed fund; deposit fee, if set, goes separately from caller to managerFeeBeneficiary. No raw prefunding, signature, arbitrary target/selector/bytes, strategy execution, approval or token-transfer capability is added.

Critical exit restriction: observed depositAllowed(Live)=true but withdrawAllowed(Live)=false on this exact deployment. Ordinary withdraw/redeem are excluded, not conditional active capabilities. Manager-only MultiWithdrawalController.multiRedeem exception processing is also excluded; no ordinary onchain request/claim method or guaranteed queue is present. Fund documentation describes manager-approved redemption, not unconditional ERC4626 liquidity.

When ordinary withdrawals are enabled, withdraw/redeem burn shares from owner; if owner differs from caller, share allowance to caller is consumed. USDC is paid to chosen receiver from fund allowance while Live, otherwise tranche assets. Receiver cannot be this tranche or its fund. Source checks controller limits, portfolio pause and minimum tranche ratios; available liquid funds and offchain manager asset reports remain material dependencies.

USDC and tranche shares use 6-decimal base units. Observed minimum deposit is 100000000000 base units (100,000 USDC), depositFeeRate=0 and managerFeeRate=0; these are mutable observations, not promises. deposit uses floor shares after floor deposit fee; mint uses ceil assets plus floor fee; withdraw uses ceil burned shares and ordinary redeem floor assets. No explicit min-shares/max-assets, slippage bound or deadline parameter exists. Protocol/manager ongoing fees accrue with elapsed time and are paid at checkpoints; source may retain unpaid fees when cash is insufficient.

Both fund and tranche use upgradeable EIP1967 proxies. Current slot observations agree with Sourcify-reported fund implementation 0xa47fabf6A2897bE0F9d49D792AA908da5031d76b and tranche implementation 0x89b9b6d707A272599031D04f64fB1Bb1E33d11Ca. Deposit/withdraw/transfer controllers, whitelist and protocol configuration are mutable dependencies; observed TransferDisabledController rejects ordinary share transfers. Full reported match labels are retained, not upgraded to exact_match.

Offchain Treasury holdings, fund custody, NAV and manager discretion remain outside static catalog guarantees. Archblock offering currently states Archblock LLC and affiliates ceased operations and entered Chapter 11, while expressly identifying accessible offerings as independently operated third-party-manager products; the exact tfBILL fund is marked Open there and Live in the maintained Brila app. No blanket TrueFi/Brila shutdown or funding/solvency inference follows.

This is Veda BoringVault architecture on Ethereum, distributed as ether.fi Liquid USD, not a new ether.fi staking label or Morpho curator rebrand. Current primary Live Vaults docs explicitly identify Veda, live accepting-deposits status and exact teller 0x4de413a26fc24c3fc27cc983be70aa9c5c299387, vault 0x08c6f91e2b681faf5e17227f2a44c307b3c1364c and queue 0x38fc1ba73b7ed289955a07d9f11a85b6e388064a. deposit(address,uint256,uint256) transfers supported ERC20 assets from msg.sender atomically into the fixed BoringVault via vault.enter and mints receipt shares only to msg.sender. Underlying allowance is to BoringVault, NOT Teller. Shares report 6 decimals; underlying amounts use their own token decimals. USDC and USDT enabled-deposit configurations and public deposit authority were observed; USDT sharePremium was 10 basis points, USDC zero, but settings are mutable.

Deposit shares floor(depositAmount * ONE_SHARE / accountant.getRateInQuoteSafe(asset)), then floor any sharePremium reduction. minimumMint protects the minimum number of minted shares; there is no deposit deadline. Rate and quote-provider configuration are external mutable dependencies; paused Accountant rejects safe pricing and stale offchain valuation is not continuously attested. Protocol/platform fees can affect vault economics; fees and returns are not assured.

The deposit ABI is payable. ERC20 deposits require msg.value=0. Its source native branch uses sentinel 0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee, wraps all msg.value through immutable nativeWrapper and overrides depositAmount with msg.value; zero value and mixed ERC20/native funding revert. Native sentinel is currently not enabled in observed assetData, so this admission does not promise native deposits. Queue methods are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Withdrawal requests escrow caller shares in the fixed queue using share allowance to that queue, not raw pool prefunding. Source requires enabled assetOut, unpaused request admission, minimum share amount, bounded discount and minimum secondsToDeadline. It fixes amountOfAssets at request-time safe Accountant rate, with floor-rounded discount and payout (uint128 bounded). This is a priced solver request, NOT immediate redemption or a guaranteed future withdrawal.

OnChainWithdraw tuple is the exact hash-bound request: nonce96, user address, assetOut address, shares128, assets128, creationTime40, maturity24 and deadline24. cancel and replace require request.user==msg.sender and exact existing hash. cancel returns escrowed shares to that user. replace retains shares, reprices at current safe rate, resets creation/maturity/window and changes nonce; it does not increase shares or choose arbitrary execution targets.

Solver fulfillment is outside this admission. After creationTime+secondsToMaturity and before that plus secondsToDeadline, an authorized solver exchanges escrowed shares for the fixed asset amount sent directly from solver to request.user. No separate user claim call is needed. Solver callback bytes/address are deliberately excluded. Expiry does not auto-return shares; unsolved exact requests can be canceled. Price variation after request is not shared with the fixed payout; no solver availability, deadline execution or complete workflow assurance.

Current BoringVault transfer hook is AtomicQueueAllowanceHook 0xdfa4f83253f72698035a7d132aa7d39b7dff90a1, not merely the teller. It calls legacyHook (observed exact teller) and blocks share transfers from accounts with nonzero share allowance to a configured blocked spender; currently legacy AtomicQueue 0xd45884b592e316eb816199615a95c182f75dea07. Such existing approvals can prevent queue escrow/return transfers. Hook set, blocked spenders, denyFrom and share locks remain mutable; no approval/revocation or hook-management capability is added.

Teller shareLockPeriod was zero at observation, not a promise. New deposits can set or reset sender unlock time if governance changes it; refundable deposits and permissioned bulk settlement remain excluded. Selected source paths require Auth checks and currently public role configuration; roles can change. Source entrypoints do not establish jurisdiction/KYC/sanctions clearance; ether.fi distribution terms and Veda terms remain applicable.

No bare BoringVault enter/exit, arbitrary manage, authority changes, role administration, permit/signature flows, cross-chain depositAndBridge/bridge, LayerZero callbacks, bulkDeposit/bulkWithdraw, or solver executor is admitted. Actual strategy allocation and backing, all other vault products and other-chain deployments are not attested.

Exact Ethereum natively issued SIERRA vault 0xbceb5f6877d979ec621ae694da1102cb95691ad3, not the bridged OFT token. The proxy uses immutable beacon/factory 0x1859161792cee3a4937f504e288a548f5c8a61fb, whose current explorer implementation getter returns LYTPool 0x2384Db821255bD89322Ec4DB35691d6d4D1E428f. Factory upgrades are authorized by the service-configuration deployer role; this is point-in-time evidence, not persistent implementation attestation.

Current flagship SIERRA is permissioned: the October 8 primary upgrade notice explicitly keeps Authorized Participant minting. Current controller reads permissionless=false, claimBasedRepayment=false, paused=false and active deposit/withdraw states; eligibility is NOT granted by catalog inclusion. AP/KYB onboarding, allow-list membership, sanctions screening, pool state and mutable pause/role controls apply.

deposit(assets,lender) requires lender=msg.sender and positive USDC assets; third-party recipient deposits revert. Shares mint to the caller and USDC is pulled by the vault from that caller, then immediately transferred to the controller-configured treasury wallet. This is managed offchain/RWA reserve exposure, not an isolated onchain ERC4626 vault or a guarantee of backing, custody, pricing or available redemption liquidity.

requestRedeem(shares) commits only msg.sender free shares to a nontransferable outstanding request and sets initial fundsDestination=msg.sender. It records gross assets at the current exchange rate, records the current redemption fee, returns net assets and emits a request UUID, but does not immediately burn shares or transfer USDC. Pending requests reserve shares against transfers and new requests; no user cancellation capability is exposed.

Ordinary issuer settlement is not admitted: the issuer later supplies settlement amounts to processRedemption or processes recorded-amount batches. Issuer admin may change a request destination to a separately allow-listed address or, outside claim mode, zero for offchain payment. Thus the initial own-wallet destination is not immutable and no automatic exact payout or payout date is promised.

Current claimBasedRepayment=false makes claim(bytes32) unavailable; it is inventoried but excluded, along with privileged openClaims, processing, destination changes, cancellation, special offchain/prefunded deposits, adjustments, rates and treasury movements. A later configuration change does not auto-admit any excluded function.

USDC and SIERRA share amounts use 6 decimals in this deployment. Conversion floors assets*1e18/exchangeRate for deposits and shares*exchangeRate/1e18 for requested gross assets; redemption fee floors gross*bps/10000. No caller minimum shares/output or deadline exists. Daily mint caps, request count caps, minimum redemption size, and current exchange-rate mode/configuration may reject calls; settings can change.

Source enforces at most 101 outstanding requests per lender via a greater-than-100 precheck, plus configured global request limits. Requested balances earn no additional request-time interest. Selected methods depend on the separately upgradeable controller, service configuration and access-control contract; their current settings are mutable, and no full dependency/runtime safety or financial suitability review is asserted.

functions.label: Anvil Deposit collateral into account ledger
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only, not live authorization, current runtime attestation, liquidity, safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Exact Ethereum Anvil CollateralVault 0x5d2725fdE4d7Aa3388DA4519ac0449Cc031d675f is a non-proxy deployment, not a generic token transfer or LOC/liquidator executor. Official pinned repository revision ced9166b130ad2bbe901070a7a50421090e06eb2 attributes this mainnet address; full deployment-bound source and ABI are retained with source-service match labels unchanged.

depositToAccount pulls each enabled ERC20 from msg.sender using allowance to this vault and credits the named account's AVAILABLE internal collateral ledger. Arrays must have equal lengths and every token must be enabled by governance. To manage own collateral use account=caller; third-party or zero-address credit is not recovered by caller authority and may strand funds. No beneficiary token allowance, reservation right, signature or operator permission is created by this method.

withdraw debits only msg.sender available balance, never another owner or reserved collateral, and sends ERC20 to an explicit NONZERO destination after subtracting the current withdrawal fee. Destination need not equal caller, so it must be intentional. Collateral already reserved for LOCs or pools must first be released through those separate financial arrangements, which are not admitted here.

The vault records nominal deposit amounts, not observed token balance increases, and nominal withdrawals, not guaranteed receiver deltas. Use only governance-enabled conventional amount-preserving ERC20s; fee-on-transfer, rebasing, malicious or restricted tokens can invalidate accounting assumptions or block exits. Quantities use each token's base units; no shares, exchange rate, minimum output or deadline is involved.

Withdrawal fee is floor(amount*basisPoints/10000), retained in the vault as protocol surplus, with a source-enforced governance maximum of 1000 basis points (10%). Current point-in-time explorer getter reports zero, not a future fee promise. No fee override or governance fee-withdrawal capability is added.

Governance may enable/disable collateral and approve collateralizable contracts. Disabling a token stops new deposits but withdraw does not check enabled status, allowing available collateral exits. Existing previously authorized reservations, collateral claims and token-specific restrictions remain effective; no claim of app/KYC/jurisdictional eligibility, backing or financial suitability is made.

Current owner read matches the documented Anvil timelock 0x4eeB7c5BB75Fc0DBEa4826BF568FD577f62cad21. Although this vault is non-proxy, token lists, fees and collateral permissions are mutable. Account-upgrade forwarding, signatures/nonces, token/collateral approvals, reserve/claim/pool surfaces and all admin/ownership functions remain excluded.

warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only: not live authorization, current runtime attestation, liquidity, backing, safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. The proxy explorer labels its source Similar Match, not exact; the implementation has full exact_match source/ABI. No legacy Plasma V1, institutional signed-order USDxMarket issuance or separate reward/service contracts are admitted.

USDx backing sits offchain at centralized exchanges/trading venues; Axis explicitly does not currently use off-exchange custody/settlement. sUSDx is an onchain claim on USDx, not segregated backing or a promise of principal or yield. Venue, counterparty, custody, hedging and reserve-verification risks remain outside this static source review.

Axis interfaces restrict Belarus, Cuba, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Iran, Libya, Myanmar, North Korea, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, United States and Yemen; USDx/sUSDx are not offered to US persons or where unlawful. Direct USDx primary-market access separately requires approved entity/wallet onboarding, KYC/KYB, accredited criteria for individuals and currently US$1 million initial minimum; retail primary-market access is not offered. None of this eligibility is granted or bypassed by staking capabilities.

deposit(assets,receiver) and mint(shares,receiver) pull USDx from msg.sender, checkpoint vesting and mint sUSDx to receiver. Use own receiver for own exposure. Both use 18-decimal USDx/sUSDx units. Conversion uses active principal plus vested rewards, not raw balance; deposit floors shares, mint rounds required assets up, with 1:1 initialization when appropriate. No caller output minimum or deadline exists.

requestRedeem(shares,controller,owner) requires caller be owner or its PREEXISTING operator AND controller or its PREEXISTING operator. Own usage sets both to caller; setOperator is excluded. It checkpoints vested rewards, burns owner shares immediately, reserves floor-converted assets, snapshots per-controller policy and eligibleAt, and returns a request ID. Request size/pause/restriction policies can reject it.

Exits are asynchronous ERC-7540: after cooldown, a REDEMPTION_SERVICER_ROLE holder must service the request before any claim. Selected withdraw/redeem are claim-only against already-serviced controller lots, not synchronous burning of live shares. Servicing is privileged and excluded; no guaranteed payout date or service availability is asserted.

redeem(shares,receiver,controller) requires controller or preexisting operator, consumes serviced lots and floors partial-lot assets. withdraw(assets,receiver,controller) rounds partial-lot shares up and some intermediate asset amounts below maxWithdraw can revert; whole-lot consumption uses exact stored shares/assets. Both transfer USDx to the specified receiver after restriction checks; use own controller/receiver for own claims.

cancelRedeemRequest(id,controller) requires controller or preexisting operator and a still-PENDING request; it releases reserved principal and remints original shares to the original owner, not the controller. Cancellation can be paused, does not promise the same economic value after intervening share-price changes, and cannot cancel serviced claims.

Soft restrictions block deposits and non-self exits; full restrictions freeze owner/controller/receiver flows and in-flight requests. Restriction role can redistribute frozen shares/requests. Admin controls independent deposit/request/claim/service/cancel/reward pauses, account policies, cooldown up to 90 days and unrelated/surplus token rescue; reward funding and service roles are excluded. Governance proxy upgrades can change code.

Observed depositPaused=false, cooldownDuration=604800 seconds (7 days), decimals=18, asset=canonical Ethereum USDx and share()=vault itself. Tuple redemption-control pause values were not returned by the static explorer read response and are not asserted. Configuration observations are not a single-block or persistent runtime attestation.

warnings: Static reviewed deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live runtime attestation, authorization, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Only the documented Ethereum Synth Engine USDC collateral and msUSD debt pair is included; not Metronome 1.0, other-chain deployments, OFT bridges, SmartFarmingManager or arbitrary strategy execution. Current proxy resolutions are DepositToken 0x68b765Ea49562D0C52D2AF4fE97dA25f70608725 and DebtToken 0x1D223BC4D041b67e0e210743f525Fcfe52f0dB1A, both version 1.4.1; governance may upgrade them.

Current official homepage continues to launch Synth Engine and describes Smart Farming evolving into Odyssey, not retirement of Synth Engine. Current Ethereum app offers USDC deposit/withdraw and msUSD generation/repayment. Point-in-time pool reads paused=false and everythingStopped=false; both target tokens isActive=true. These observations are not future availability promises or an assertion that every collateral/synth remains supported.

deposit(amount,onBehalfOf) pulls caller USDC directly to the pool treasury using allowance and measures treasury balance increase, subtracts the configured deposit fee and mints 1:1 net collateral-ledger tokens to a nonzero beneficiary. Use beneficiary=caller for own collateral; third-party credit does not give caller withdrawal rights. USDC and its deposit units have 6 decimals; this is collateral accounting, not an ERC4626 yield-share exchange rate.

withdraw(amount,to) spends only caller unlocked deposit-token balance, transfers fee-denominated deposit tokens to the fee collector, burns net tokens and asks treasury to send net USDC to a nonzero explicit receiver. Locked collateral supporting debt cannot be withdrawn. The chosen receiver need not equal caller. There is no minimum output or deadline; treasury liquidity, collateral valuation, fees and token restrictions may block calls.

issue(amount,to) accrues interest, checks caller collateral headroom through the pool oracle, and creates gross msUSD debt on caller while minting net synthetic msUSD to the chosen receiver and fee to collector. Set receiver=caller for own borrowing. Debt and synthetic msUSD units use 18 decimals; mutable interest, mint caps, debt floor, collateral factors, asset enablement and oracle state apply. This is collateralized borrowing with liquidation risk, not yield or stable-peg assurance.

repay(onBehalfOf,amount) burns caller msUSD and seizes caller fee msUSD without requiring ordinary ERC20 approval, decreasing the specified account debt by the net amount. Use onBehalfOf=caller for own repayment; third-party repayment does not grant management rights. amount is gross and is not automatically capped to debt, so overrepayment or remaining debt below a configured floor can revert. repayAll(onBehalfOf) obtains current entire debt plus fee after interest accrual and burns/seizes that caller-funded amount; it has no caller maximum spend parameter.

Deposit/withdraw/issue fees use 1e18-scaled WadRayMath multiplication rounded half-up, repay gross/net division rounds half-up; repayAll adds the rounded fee to the full debt amount. These methods provide no fee slippage bound. Pool treasury, fee provider, oracle, rewards distributors, registry, synthetic-token roles and governance are external mutable dependencies; catalog admission does not review their entire runtime or confer preexisting eligibility.

Views, token approvals/transfers, delegated withdrawFrom, restricted seizure/mint/burnFor, flash paths, fee collection, interest-maintenance-only calls, initialization and governance/configuration/sweep/proxy upgrades are all inventoried and excluded.

functions.label: CLever Claim own accrued or future CVX yields
warnings: Static reviewed deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live runtime attestation, authorization, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent explicit grants, pauses, policies and canonical calldata validation remain mandatory; all selected functions are nonpayable and require zero native value.

CLever is its own Ethereum future-yield/debt product with clevCVX, CVXLocker and Furnace, documented separately from Concentrator yield vaults and f(x) leveraged stablecoins; this is not a curator alias or a new Concentrator share class. Only its CVXLocker deployment 0x96C68D861aDa016Ed98c30C810879F9df7c64154 is admitted, with current CLeverCVXLocker implementation 0xBfb3A7A5FbB9207dEA82fe06dB4075B8CAEDa534. Source-service proxy match is match, implementation exact_match; these labels are not interchangeable.

Current primary CLever app offers lock, unlock and claim future CVX yields, linked official docs retain this exact CVXLocker; October 2026 explorer transactions show deposit, borrow, repay and unlock rather than only recovery. Zero placeholders in the disconnected JavaScript app are not TVL evidence. No CLever USD, deprecated liquidity gauge or retired pool is silently substituted.

deposit(amount) pulls positive caller CVX into the locker, approves and locks it in fixed Convex CVXLockerV2 0x72a19342e8F1838460eBFCCEf09F6585e32db86E for this contract, credits only caller lock ledger, and updates caller rewards/debt first. CVX and clevCVX use 18-decimal base units. CVX remains exposed to Convex lock timing and protocol/contract risks, not immediately liquid shares.

borrow(amount,depositToFurnace) consumes caller accrued rewards first without adding debt; any excess increases caller debt subject to remaining locked CVX * reserveRate >= total debt * 1e9. It mints clevCVX to caller if false; if true it mints to locker then deposits for caller into the configured fixed Furnace. There is no caller target, selector or opaque execution bytes. Furnace is a separately mutable dependency and this boolean path does not admit its external methods or imply immediate CVX redemption.

repay(unusedCVXAmount,clevCVXAmount) ignores the FIRST uint256 in the current implementation; pass zero there. It updates rewards, caps the positive clevCVX amount to caller remaining debt, transfers floor(amount*repayFeePercentage/1e9) clevCVX fee from caller to platform, and burns caller clevCVX via burnFrom. Token allowance to locker and fee funding may be required. It does not repay with CVX despite legacy parameter documentation. Point-in-time repayFeePercentage=0 is not a future fee promise; source maximum is 10%.

They are BeaconProxy targets; pinned beacon implementation() reads resolve current DirectDepositor 0x0BFE61C05424A643301FD50981c4A61F2D5234a4, AsyncRedeemer 0x49C4762Ab838F2E5d8252b69b90a1e8587A74511 and Machine 0x6A759cae19Aa25b41237089eb0BbbC4473bFB996. Beacons/upgrades and mutable governance can change behavior; this is point-in-time binding, not persistent attestation.

Makina official January 26 2026 re-activation statement says the January 20 DUSD/USDC Curve exploit caused precautionary Recovery Mode for DUSD, DETH and DBIT, then v1.1 upgrades disabled Recovery Mode and restored normal Machine operations/redemptions. Current deployment docs list live strategies and Ethereum block 26256992 reads DUSD recoveryMode=false, nonzero maxMint and maxWithdraw, and matching deposit/redeem endpoints. The separate recovery-note NFT product and frozen/recovery-only exit surfaces are not admitted, and restitution does not establish loss elimination or safety.

DirectDepositor.deposit pulls caller USDC into the depositor, sets its internal allowance to the Machine and calls the fixed Machine deposit. Only the configured depositor may invoke Machine.deposit. The Machine computes floor(assets*(shareSupply+10**offset)/(lastTotalAum+1)), enforces share limit and minShares, then pulls assets and mints shares to receiver. Receiver is explicit and need not be caller: use own wallet for own deposits. referralKey is inert bytes32 referral attribution emitted by Machine, not execution data or permission.

AsyncRedeemer.requestRedeem pulls caller-owned DUSD shares into escrow and safe-mints a queue NFT to explicit receiver. It checks current estimated assets >= minAssets and configured minimum shares. Use receiver=caller for own position; choosing another recipient transfers the redemption entitlement, and a contract recipient must accept ERC721. Prior share allowance is required but not granted here. No strategy execution, arbitrary targets or permit/signature authority is added.

Queue settlement is asynchronous and requires the separately privileged mechanic to finalize; that function is excluded. Current finalizationDelay is 172800 seconds (two days), not a completion guarantee. Finalization resets each request payout to min(request-time assets,current estimated assets), so request minAssets is NOT a guaranteed settlement floor and positive share-price changes after requesting are not credited. Settlement remains subject to Machine liquidity, recovery mode and operator accounting.

claimAssets(requestId) requires msg.sender be the CURRENT NFT owner, not merely an approved operator, and a finalized request. It burns the NFT, deletes its request and transfers recorded USDC to that owner; there is no caller-chosen claim recipient. Existing NFT ownership can change through separately excluded transfers. Sanctions and whitelist checks apply to the caller at deposit, request and claim; current checks are sanctions enabled and whitelist disabled, both mutable. Catalog membership never grants AML/KYC, whitelist or jurisdictional eligibility.

USDC amounts use 6 decimals and DUSD shares 18. Asset/share conversions floor with virtual asset/share offsets and reported lastTotalAum, not guaranteed realizable backing or immediate market price. Managed-strategy valuation, dilution from protocol/strategy fees, cross-chain positions and mutable governance affect outcomes. Bridge management, accounting updates, recovery toggles, fee administration, NFT/ERC20 transfers/approvals, roles and opaque execution surfaces are excluded. Only local fixed financial entry/request/claim methods are admitted; no cross-chain execution scope is added.

deposit(deposit0,deposit1,to) pulls nominal enabled ERC20 quantities from msg.sender to this vault and mints shares to explicit nonzero recipient other than the vault. To retain own receipt ownership use to=caller. Current allowToken0=false and allowToken1=true require deposit0=0 and WETH token1 funding; ETH is not automatically wrapped. Deposits use token base units, must be positive overall and strictly less than both configured per-token maxima. Current deposit1Max is 3957000000000000000000 WETH base units; maxTotalSupply=0 means no aggregate cap. Owner can change maxima, TWAP period, hysteresis and aggregate cap; reported registry flags are not persistent execution assurance.

Deposit valuation uses min(spot,TWAP) for incoming token0 and max(spot,TWAP) for existing token0 AUM with PRECISION=1e18, flooring divisions. Initial shares are token1-valued deposits; later shares multiply by current supply over valued AUM. Share decimals are 18. There is no minShares or deadline parameter, and tiny deposits may mint zero shares. Spot/TWAP and hysteresis checks can reject deposits.

withdraw(shares,to) burns only msg.sender shares, proportionally removes the base and limit Uniswap liquidity, collects released principal to the chosen nonzero recipient and sends a proportional share of idle token0/token1 balances. Outputs can include both DEXTF and WETH even though ingress is WETH only. Recipient is explicit and need not equal caller; no owner/delegated-share debit path, queue or later claim is exposed.

Withdrawal floors proportional liquidity and idle balances and has no minimum outputs or deadline. Source withdraw collects liquidity released by that burn with collectAll=false; accumulated position fees are not automatically all realized by each withdrawal. Fee collection/reinvestment is owner-managed rebalance activity, which remains excluded.

Owner controls rebalancing positions and fixed-pool swaps; factory controls fee recipient, base fee and affiliate split. Rebalance distributes floor(fees*baseFee/1e18) with baseFee allowed up to 1e18. No callback, admin, raw prefunding, approvals/transfers or generic execution method is admitted.

This admission adds native staking/queue/claim only; privileged signature-based AvantMintingV2 mint/redeem, MAX, bridges, strategy trade execution, roles, permits and authorization remain excluded.

deposit(assets,receiver) pulls avETH from msg.sender using preexisting allowance and mints savETH to receiver; mint(shares,receiver) computes and pulls required avETH from msg.sender and mints the requested shares. Receiver is explicit and need not be caller: use an intentional eligible address. No permit or wallet signature is granted. Positive assets AND shares and minimum residual total supply apply.

Both assets and shares use 18 decimals. Exact inherited accounting uses (totalSupply+1)/(totalAssets+1), where totalAssets subtracts linearly unvested rewards over eight hours. deposit rounds shares down; mint rounds assets up; cooldownAssets rounds shares up; cooldownShares rounds avETH down. There is no caller min-output, max-input or deadline parameter and no separate deposit/withdraw fee deduction in these selected bodies; managed yield, base redemption fees and risks are separate.

Current cooldownDuration=86400 seconds at pinned Ethereum block 0x190a665 (matching current primary docs 24 hours), not the constructor default seven days. Direct ERC4626 withdraw/redeem require duration=0 and are excluded because currently disabled. Governance can set cooldown from zero to 90 days; a setting change does not automatically admit previously excluded functions.

cooldownAssets(assets) and cooldownShares(shares) operate only on msg.sender shares while cooldown is nonzero. They immediately burn the calculated shares and move fixed converted avETH into the immutable silo, accumulate uint152 underlyingAmount and reset the ENTIRE existing cooldownEnd to now+current duration. Calling again delays previously queued funds; queued assets earn no further vault yield. Source casts underlying amount to uint152, so callers must keep each amount and accumulated queue within that representable bound; catalog does not add argument-range enforcement.

unstake(receiver) uses only msg.sender cooldown credit, pays the entire recorded amount from the immutable silo once mature (or cooldown has been disabled), clears the credit and timer first, and returns without transfer when no credit exists. Receiver is user-chosen; no ownership/delegation of another queue is enabled. Silo.withdraw is callable only by the vault and is not admitted directly.

Soft blacklist blocks deposits for caller/receiver; full restrictions also block transfers, minting to restricted receivers, and withdrawal/cooldown caller/owner/receiver paths. Governance can redistribute a fully restricted savETH share balance, manage blacklist roles, and change cooldown; these authority surfaces are excluded. unstake itself has no additional blacklist check in its body, although underlying-token restrictions can still prevent payment.

Minimum nonzero total savETH supply is 1e13 units (0.00001 savETH); deposit/mint/cooldown revert if resulting total supply is nonzero below that threshold. No persistent runtime, asset solvency/backing, managed strategy performance, guaranteed yield, payout or WETH redemption claim is made. Native Ethereum savETH lifecycle is independently documented; unsupported Avalanche base products are not admitted.

functions.label: 3Jane Lending USD3: deposit
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not an API-key grant, persistent runtime attestation, live availability, financial safety, backing, liquidity or successful execution assurance. Independent grants, policy, pause and canonical calldata/value checks remain mandatory. All selected methods are nonpayable and require zero native value.

3Jane owns the Ethereum USD3 USDC senior lending product and sUSD3 junior receipt product. These are custom upgradeable strategies using fixed deployed TokenizedStrategy singleton 0xd377919fa87120584b21279a491f82d5265a139c, not a generic ERC4626 ABI substitution. Current USD3 implementation is 0xd1f1c3f485063712873285bf4ef25ab068f13893; sUSD3 implementation is 0x6093d95f6c102163d19f5681e7d84997060bbaed. Transparent proxy admins can upgrade them. The sUSD3 proxy source is Blockscout partial verification (not exact_match); its current implementation and fixed singleton each have Sourcify match/match.

No borrower origination, credit line increase, proof, account-operation bytes, financial authorization signature, permit, arbitrary executor or new signing scope is admitted. Borrowers still require the protocol existing underwriting/credit eligibility and configured line. USD3 availableDepositLimit rejects receivers with existing borrowShares; admission never grants borrowing or onboarding eligibility.

USD3 deposits/mints pull USDC from msg.sender and mint 6-decimal USD3 shares to receiver. Assets are 6-decimal USDC; deposit floors shares, mint rounds USDC upward, and zero-result operations revert. uint256.max deposit means caller full asset balance. First-time non-exempt receivers need the current minimum (1,000 USDC at block 26256996); supply-cap-exempt receivers require self-deposits. Caps and eligibility can change.

At pinned block 26256996 USD3 was NOT shutdown, but ordinary maxDeposit/availableDepositLimit for the probe address was zero: configured supply cap 100,000,000 USDC was below totalAssets 100,575,342.759921 USDC. Deposit/mint capabilities are static source metadata, not a claim that new ordinary deposits currently succeed. USD3 availableWithdrawLimit was positive, and current sUSD3 maxDeposit was positive. This is not a sunset/exit-only admission.

USD3 deploys through fixed waEthUSDC wrapper 0xd4fa2d31b7968e448877f69a96de69f5de8cd23e and 3Jane MorphoCredit. Pending unreported losses can block deposits/deployment or withdrawals. Withdrawal availability is bounded by wrapper/Morpho liquidity, ring-fenced capital-call cash, nominal/bps redemption floors and mutable protocol config. Senior holders remain exposed after locked-profit and junior buffers are exhausted; no backing or loss-protection assurance is made.

sUSD3 deposits/mints pull existing USD3, not USDC. Self-deposit (receiver=msg.sender) is required unless caller is ALREADY in the depositor whitelist; catalog inclusion does not confer that permission. A deposit extends receiver lock by the configured lockDuration. Capacity is bounded by subordination debt cap and pending-loss checks. USD3 and sUSD3 both use 6 decimals.

startCooldown(shares) records only caller own positive existing sUSD3 shares after lock expiry; it replaces the prior request, sets cooldownEnd and windowEnd, and transfers/burns nothing. cancelCooldown deletes caller active cooldown and pays nothing. Withdrawal needs lock expiry, a matured still-open cooldown when enabled, enough recorded shares and backing-floor headroom. Successful partial withdrawals reduce cooldown shares; a full withdrawal clears cooldown and zero share balance clears the lock.

withdraw/redeem burn owner shares and transfer asset to receiver; a third-party caller needs preexisting owner allowance. withdraw rounds required shares upward; redeem floors assets. Four-argument maxLoss is basis points, <=10,000, allowing realized shortfall up to that tolerance. THREE-ARGUMENT withdraw defaults to ZERO loss; THREE-ARGUMENT redeem defaults to 10,000 bps (100% loss), so use the explicit overload when a bounded loss is needed. No catalog policy sets a loss bound for the user.

The junior receipt takes first-loss exposure and redeems into USD3, not immediately USDC. USD3/sUSD3 pending-loss gates, current lock/cooldown/window, backing floors, fees/profit-unlock accounting, mutable management and external credit recoverability can alter availability and value. No full deposit-to-exit workflow, funded execution or jurisdiction/suitability determination is asserted.

Primary FAQ credit-line eligibility includes U.S.-based qualifying onchain history, Credit Karma and bank-account checks, a minimum verified balance and the protocol credit box. Those are preexisting borrower restrictions, not lending permission granted here. FAQ describes a one-month junior lock, but pinned live sUSD3 lockDuration was 0 and cooldownDuration was 2,592,000 seconds (30 days); current configuration, not generic documentation prose, controls execution.

functions.label: Meta Pool stake weth
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only: not persistent runtime attestation, live authorization, balances, liquidity, financial safety, backing, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory. Only depositETH is payable; all other selected Meta Pool methods require zero native value.

This is current Ethereum spETH 0xD06f6a56c5f599cB375B616DF306f32B7F6f4A0E, not compromised legacy mpETH. Current primary deployment and product docs advertise normal ETH staking plus fast and delayed unstaking; current source initialize explicitly replaces balances from the June 17, 2025 incident. No recovery distribution or legacy mint method is admitted. Documentation is normal-product lifecycle evidence, not a new audit, safety assurance or a claim about incident reimbursement.

Current EIP1967 source-service resolution identifies staking implementation 0xD3dB79D2D00A6B82531D8Ccf65C376d9eE9513aC, withdrawal implementation 0xcB894c063c74053c9401ac8FDd9A9f2bb1a03c61 and liquid pool implementation 0xeA9fec1ff24B523424F21eeA5c249f9b29A1AA81. Exact source-service match labels are retained, including non-exact match for Withdrawal implementation. All are upgradeable, and staking admin may change withdrawal and pool dependencies; no persistent implementation binding is implied.

depositETH(receiver) funds staking using msg.value; deposit(assets,receiver) and mint(shares,receiver) atomically pull WETH from msg.sender and unwrap it. A minimum 0.01 ETH equivalent applies. Shares may be sourced from the configured liquid pool before new minting. Receiver chooses share ownership and must be intentional; use own wallet for own staking. Existing WETH allowance is required but no approval capability is added.

ETH, WETH and spETH use 18-decimal base units. Vendored ERC4626 conversions use virtual assets and shares: shares=floor(assets*(totalSupply+1)/(totalAssets+1)); mint rounds assets up, withdraw rounds burned shares up, redeem rounds assets down. totalAssets uses updater-reported underlying and signed estimated rewards, not a raw onchain balance or backing proof. Share-rate estimates, losses and fees can change; entry methods have no minimum-shares or deadline parameter.

Entry fee is taken from the gross shares before transfer to receiver (except pool caller), so returned/event shares and requested mint shares are gross, not guaranteed receiver-net shares. Admin may set depositFee up to 100 bps and rewardFee up to 2000 bps; current explorer reads depositFee=0 and rewardsFee=500. Whitelist is source-enforced on caller when enabled; current explorer reads whitelistEnabled=false, not a future access promise or jurisdiction/eligibility clearance.

withdraw(assets,receiver,owner) and redeem(shares,receiver,owner) are ASYNCHRONOUS requests, not immediate WETH/ETH payment: burn owner shares, decrease totalUnderlying and queue ETH owed in Withdrawal. If caller differs from owner it consumes owner share allowance. Critically the queue is keyed to caller, NOT owner: use owner=caller for own positions; allowance does not create an owner-keyed claim.

Each new request accumulates caller pending amount, resets unlockEpoch to currentEpoch+1, and OVERWRITES the receiver for the entire accumulated request. Seven-day epochs plus mutable validatorsDisassembleTime determine claim time; current getter reads 604800 seconds, yielding approximately 7–14 days, while source permits up to 90 days additional delay. Current epoch171 exceeds withdrawalsStartEpoch10. No request cancellation, immutable recipient, fixed maturity or validator-exit/liquidity guarantee is asserted.

completeWithdraw() claims only msg.sender pending ledger to its recorded receiver (zero receiver falls back to caller), requires unlock time and sufficient native ETH, decrements totalPendingWithdraw and deletes caller request before sending ETH. Failed receiver payment or insufficient funds reverts. It cannot independently select another claim owner or change receiver.

swapmpETHforETH(amount,minOut) on the documented liquid pool is current spETH FAST unstaking despite legacy method naming: pulls caller spETH under existing allowance and pays native ETH only to caller. minOut bounds net output. Dynamic fee floors spETH amount*feeBps/10000, then converts net shares to ETH; current reads minFee25, maxFee1000, treasuryFee2500 and targetLiquidity21 ETH. Governance may change these; implementation allows maxFee up to1000 and treasury fraction up to7000 bps. Full pre-fee gross ETH must fit tracked pool liquidity; no deadline or guaranteed reserves exists.

Role/admin/upgrades, initializer/recovery distributor, reports and validator activation, signatures, approvals/transfers, pool-only swaps/validator funding, and LP accounting are excluded. Pool LP mint is inherited rather than the staking override and is not admitted. Mutable oracle, validator, treasury, withdrawal and pool behavior remains outside static metadata guarantees.

Exact Ethereum Saffron current fixed-income UniV3Vault with own fixed and variable bearer claims over one bound USDC/WETH Uniswap V3 position; not legacy Saffron V1, a curator label or generic liquidity router. Full deployed vault and bound adapter ABI/source retained; both are non-proxy Sourcify creation/runtime match, not exact_match.

side=0 is FIXED; side=1 is VARIABLE. Fixed entry requires amount=0, sole fixed claim slot unfilled, and deployCapitalData=abi.encode(uint256 amount0Min,uint256 amount1Min,uint256 deadline). Its bound adapter pulls current-price-derived USDC/WETH amounts directly from msg.sender using PREEXISTING allowances to adapter, creates its own Uniswap NFT and returns unused amounts to caller. No standalone prefunding/public mint shortcut.

Variable entry pulls caller USDC using preexisting allowance to vault and issues variable bearer units 1:1 with actual accepted amount. Deposit clips to remaining capacity; optional bytes abi.encode(uint256 minAcceptedAmount) protects partial fills, otherwise empty bytes permits any positive accepted amount. USDC uses 6-decimal base units; fixedSideCapacity is Uniswap liquidity units, not USDC amount or vault shares.

Bytes are only decoded into scalar minimum amounts/deadlines (or variable minimum accepted amount); neither bytes nor side controls arbitrary targets, selectors or calls. Vault adapter/pool and immutable Uniswap position manager are deployment-bound; direct adapter callback/capital-control, initialize and factory creation/admin calls remain excluded.

When both sides fill, vault starts automatically and funds lock until block.timestamp > endTime (duration 1209600 seconds at initialization). Before start, withdraw can exit caller entire selected-side position. No cancellation/early exit after start; claim() after start burns caller claimToken and mints fixedBearerToken while transferring current proportional USDC premium balance to caller. This is not ERC4626 or instant redemption.

Before start fixed exit burns caller claim token and unwinds full LP position with removeLiquidityData=abi.encode(uint256 amount0Min,uint256 amount1Min,uint256 deadline); variable exit requires empty bytes and returns caller full variable principal. After maturity fixed exit requires fixed bearer balance and same typed liquidity data; variable exit requires empty bytes, burns caller variable bearer balance and returns proportional USDC/WETH trading fees, NOT guaranteed original USDC premium principal.

First mature withdrawal settles earnings and mints vault-held protocol variable bearer tokens using floor(supply*feeBps/(10000-feeBps)); current feeBps is initialized to 1250. Payout proportions use nested floor mulDiv rounding and reduce remaining earnings/supply. Current factory feeReceiver can claim vault-held fee tokens through the same variable withdrawal, but no role/fee entitlement is granted by this catalog.

Position tokens are transferable bearer claims; claim/exit entitlement follows caller current token balance, not original depositor identity. Selected methods have no arbitrary recipient or owner parameter: caller receives funds and caller claims burn. Premium, fee earnings, liquidity value, slippage, capital loss, asset restrictions, taxes and eligibility remain user risks; no APY/backing/safety guarantee.

Vault initialized adapter/capacities/duration/asset/fee cannot be reinitialized; adapter vault binding prevents later initialization. Current factory supplies mutable feeReceiver getter and remains a dependency. Plain mint/redeem methods pull only msg.sender funds. Only registered enabled collateral can be used. Mint deposits caller collateral into its configured yield wrapper and invokes immutable core mint; fee is retained in ftUSD. Redemption uses conservative spot/average-mint factors, not unconditional 1:1 redemption; fees and mutable oracle/wrapper behavior matter.

Circuit breakers can queue minted ftUSD recipient transfers; the mint return amount does not guarantee immediate receipt. Redemption burns net ftUSD then asks configured wrapper to withdraw collateral to recipient, potentially returning a queue ID. Queue claim/cancellation contracts are not admitted here; no complete exit workflow or payout date is promised.

The Ethereum transparent proxy 0xc10214cde5d6754ec1e2220362f2120142c8e5e8 currently resolves through Sourcify and Etherscan to TruStakePOL implementation 0xb41ccc7695281e60cef2e6741819e338b58e9d9c. Deposits pull ERC20 POL only from msg.sender, mint caller TruPOL shares at floor conversion and stake through a configured enabled validator. Asset/share units are 18 decimals; minimum deposit is owner configured. No selected deposit provides minimum shares or deadline protection. Withdrawal amounts are POL assets, not shares. Requests burn caller shares rounded up; if remaining max entitlement would be below 1 POL and the validator can cover all, the code withdraws the full entitlement and burns all caller shares. A request returns burned shares and an unbond nonce, not immediately spendable POL. Validator stake limits and Polygon unbonding delay apply.

withdrawClaim and claimList require the nonce withdrawal owner to equal msg.sender; payout is the actual POL balance increase returned by validator, which need not equal the recorded requested amount. Delay is enforced by the external validator claim, not a guaranteed wall-clock date. claimList has no source-enforced array cap; a failed leg reverts the batch.

sharePrice accounts for staked POL, idle POL and unprocessed validator rewards plus forced legacy MATIC net of configured fee; deposit/withdraw/compound may mint treasury fee shares. Legacy MATIC synchronization calls only the configured Polygon migration and catches failure, leaving net-of-fee legacy value in share pricing. That assumption and dependencies do not establish backing or loss protection.

compoundRewards attempts restaking across enabled validators, catches Error(string) failures and emits RestakeError, mints fee shares, and stakes idle POL to the provided enabled validator when idle assets exist. It changes the pooled financial position, not caller reward entitlement or arbitrary call authority; no complete compounding outcome is promised.

Refinancing rewrites the hashed loan under a new loan ID, invalidating old state; use the exact emitted updated loan/tranches. No grant administration, revocation, delegation, approvals, NFT transfers or arbitrary execution is admitted.

Bound createPlan pulls exactly amount from msg.sender into financial escrow, stores rate/period/cliff/start, and mints a nontransferable beneficiary NFT; no grant-admin input. Amount/rate are native ERC20 base units; timestamps and periods are seconds. Amount and rate must be positive, rate <= amount, period > 0, cliff <= rounded-up schedule end. Future or past starts are allowed; recipient controls redemption.

Zero-claim plans are skipped. partialRedeemPlans requires a strictly past redemption timestamp; eligibility uses the current block timestamp for start/cliff gates and floors elapsed periods. This is a fixed financial ledger batch, not an arbitrary-call batch.

Full redemption deletes the plan and burns its NFT; partial redemption updates remaining amount and start to latest scheduled unlock. Tokens must satisfy exact balance-delta checks on funding and payout; taxed/rebasing tokens may fail. There is no protocol fee or native payment in selected methods; zero native value is required. No queue or loss protection is provided.

Vesting beneficiaries retain only their vested settlement right; existing plan vesting-admin can revoke unvested amounts and, if its existing adminTransferOBO flag permits, relocate the plan. This admission grants none of that authority and does not create revocable vesting plans. Bound lockups are not revocable or transferable.

createVestingToken deploys an immutable EIP1167 clone to the fixed implementation and initializes only typed name/symbol/underlying token and milestone tuples; no arbitrary init bytes, call targets or code can be supplied. It creates an empty schedule, not a funded allocation. Newly returned clone addresses are NOT dynamically admitted, and require separate future review.

The admitted existing clone fixes underlying token 0x4feb2b8827b2241f382c2fa7ad89f3c6fb0e673d, manager=factory, 15% milestone at 1772206200 and final 100% cliff at 1803655844. Point-in-time unlockedPercentage was 0.15e18 and totalSupply was zero; this proves neither live use nor backing. No funded claim is promised; no asset legitimacy, token behavior or economic endorsement is asserted.

addRecipient/addRecipients pull only msg.sender underlying tokens and mint vesting-ledger receipts to designated recipients under the already fixed schedule, with no administrator assignment. Amounts are underlying-token base units, not 18-decimal percentages. No native value is permitted for these nonpayable funding calls.

Milestone percentages use 1e18=100%, timestamps use seconds and ramp enum 0=cliff/1=linear. Late funding inherits the existing absolute-time unlock percentage rather than restarting vesting. Factory creation fee requires at least configured wei fee when nonzero and forwards the whole msg.value (no excess refund); with a zero creation fee unexpected value remains in factory. Pay only the required fee; native value limits and independent policies still apply.

Factory fee owner can change global/custom fees and fee collector subject to source scheduling; clone permanent custom fee may instead bind its fees at creation. No fee-admin methods are admitted. Fee payment is a fixed financial fee transfer, not arbitrary execution. Tokens may have loss, transfer taxes, rebases or malicious callbacks; no protection or unconditional payout guarantee. There is no withdrawal queue.

Deployment lineage uses current primary v3.1 address documentation, explorer factory internal creation and clone implementation resolution, plus observed clone runtime and manager reads. The queried creation receipt returned null from the public RPC; no receipt/log validation is claimed. Primary mint/redeem is for Authorized Users under KYC/KYB and configured Keyring credentials/whitelist; blacklists and pause apply.
