Pool tradingModel() is OrderBook=1, so enterLiquidity, enterLiquidityBatch and removeLiquidity are structurally inapplicable and excluded even though routed. No AMM liquidity capability, arbitrary executor, user-programmable callback, wallet authorization, permit, role mutation or new off-chain signing capability is admitted.

USD₮0 base token 0xfd086bc7cd5c481dcc9c85ebe478a1c0b69fcbb9 uses 6 decimals; baseTokenDecimals() returns scale factor 1000000, not the integer decimal count. Outcome shares are internal accounting in base-unit scale, not transferable ERC20 tokens. Order prices are 1e18-scaled with configured tick/range rules; integer divisions floor fills, fees and payouts.

enterOption and placeBuyOrder pull only msg.sender approved base funds; order fills credit caller internal outcome shares. enterOption uses minSharesOut and deadline and refunds unfilled base; sellOption sells only caller unescrowed shares and enforces net-base minAmountOut and deadline. Partial sells leave unfilled shares with caller. These methods match only fixed on-chain order data, not opaque API calldata.

placeBuyOrder/placeSellOrder use a finite option/side/price/amount/postOnly interface. Resting buy orders escrow caller base; sell orders escrow only caller existing outcome shares. postOnly rejects crossing orders; otherwise matching and partial fills can occur before a remainder rests. Orders have no caller deadline or separate slippage bound beyond limit price. There are configured entry/dust minima, 50 active-order limits and maker rebates/protocol fees. Small base remainders are refunded; small share remainders remain available. Gas can grow with traversed book depth.

cancelBuyOrders/cancelSellOrders require each order maker to equal msg.sender and parallel arrays to match; cancellation returns only remaining own base escrow or releases own share escrow. It remains possible after trading phases, so existing escrow can be cleared before claim; races with fills can invalidate orders.

split pulls caller collateral and creates equal YES/NO internal shares; merge consumes equal caller unescrowed YES/NO shares and returns same-unit base. Both operate only before permanent option finalization and reject zero. No shared raw pool prefunding or public-mint workaround is used.

claim is caller-specific, one-time, after option finalization and dispute window. It requires no outstanding caller order escrow and pays pro-rata winning direct/LP shares and fees, with floor rounding; losing positions may receive zero and be ineligible. The first claim also settles fixed creator/platform/resolver/referrer/dispute/bond recipients and may invoke configured appeal-oracle refund. User cannot choose arbitrary targets or executable data. There is no payout minimum or guaranteed settlement date; resolver/oracle decisions can affect outcomes.

Money-moving methods use an accounted balance-delta hook whose ledger address is read from factory.accounting(); ledger authorization, mutable solvency gates or a dependency revert can block operations. Resolver/dispute authorities are likewise factory-dependent; external token, factory, accounting ledger and oracle independent source/runtime/safety attestations are not established. Resolution/dispute/operator functions are not granted here, so no complete market-creation/resolution workflow is promised.

Preexisting Dexalot swapSigner counterparty quote signature is data only. Source EIP-712 domain Dexalot/version 1 binds chain and verifying proxy; signature commits nonceAndMeta, expiry, maker/taker assets and addresses, and both amounts. Sender must equal taker or signed destination encoded in nonceAndMeta. Nonce bitmap is consumed once, including partial fills. No new wallet/backend message or typed-data signing, permit or authorization admitted; never trust API calldata wholesale.

Direct calls pull ERC20 input only from msg.sender under existing allowance, or require msg.value >= native input and refund excess. Non-native input requires zero msg.value. Asset address(0) means native ETH; token amounts use their own base units, not universal 18 decimals. Maker output comes from RFQ contract inventory, not an arbitrary external maker call. Configured WETH wrapping applies; no arbitrary-call payload or user callback exists in selected methods.

Output goes to signed nonceAndMeta high-160-bit destination, potentially not caller. partialSwap scales maker output downward by floor(makerAmount*actualTaker/quotedTaker) only when actual input is below quote; input above quote is NOT rejected and DOES NOT increase quoted maker amount. Partial fill exhausts quote nonce; do not treat it as reusable remaining balance.

Quote output can be reduced using signed slippage metadata and mutable volatility-admin slippagePoints: precision 1,000,000, configured points capped 50,000 (5%). Time curve or always-slip mode applies. There is no separate caller minimum-output argument or standalone fee line; quoted price/spread and slippage determine proceeds. Expiry verification casts order.expiry to uint32 while signature commits uint128; source must not be read as a generic unbounded timestamp guarantee.

Source simpleSwap/partialSwap do not use whenNotPaused; paused=false point-in-time observation is not a future execution guarantee or an assertion pause gates these methods. Finite fixed-asset settlement is atomic or reverts on insufficient inventory; selected same-chain methods do not enqueue. Portfolio deposits/withdrawals to Dexalot L1 chain 432204, cross-chain swaps/messages/queue completion, rebalancer custody withdrawals, trusted-forwarder and role/admin controls are excluded. Base/BSC roots are not admitted by this record.

warnings: Static source/deployment/ABI metadata only, not live authorization, persistent runtime identity, backing, financial safety, liquidity, successful execution or a complete workflow. Arbitrum AUSTINEP23 dividend module only, discovered from the current primary marketplace property token 0x17af69414ebaeeafbd8e00bc7b223a0b7330578c via getModulesByType(4). Current proxy implementation is 0x5968ad21e06213d3df7c6bd65bc8dbd4f33f1c1a, resolved from source-defined storage slot 11 and owner-context eth_call implementation(). pullDividendPayment(index) pays only msg.sender according to that holder's property-token balance at the recorded checkpoint, not current balance or a user-supplied recipient. Eligibility/exclusion and claimed flags, non-reclaimed status, maturity <= now < expiry, and not-paused state all apply. No KYC or operator grant is added; property token purchase/onboarding is outside this scope.

Gross claim floors balanceOfAt(msg.sender,checkpointId) * dividend.amount / dividend.totalSupply. Withholding floors gross * withholdingTax[msg.sender] / 1e18; the holder receives gross minus withheld, and withheld amount remains tracked for issuer withdrawal. Distribution token is per dividend; observed index 0 uses native Arbitrum USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cc2239327c5edb3a432268e5831 with 6 decimals. This is finite funded dividend accounting, not a fixed rent/APY promise.

Claimed flag and claimedAmount accounting are updated before ERC20 transfer; a zero entitlement can still be marked claimed. Withholding, dates, exclusion defaults, wallet, pause state and proxy implementation are mutable by privileged parties. Expired unclaimed funds can be reclaimed by issuer; no indefinite claim right or queue/payout-time guarantee exists.

At observation dividend index 0 matures 2025-12-15T23:12:00Z and expires 2026-12-15T23:13:00Z, has not been reclaimed, and paused() is false. These are point-in-time source/state anchors, not a continuing execution promise. Current marketplace retains this property and current frontend invokes pullDividendPayment for rent claims.
